snippet.title: MXGP 26 - The Official Game | Warm Up Trailer
snippet.description:
MXGP 26 - The Official Game releases October 2026! Thanks to the transition to Unreal Engine 5, MXGP 26 achieves a historic visual milestone. With top riders such as Jeffrey Herlings, Lucas Coenen and Tim Gajser, MXGP 26 is your go to!

Experience fully rewritten motorcycle physics, and completely reworked rider animations and the terrain in MXGP 26 is now alive. Dynamic deformation technology alters the track as riders pass through.

Official 2026 season content in the spotlight! Here are the details below!

· Iconic Tracks: Including Bariloche in Argentina (volcanic soil), Riola Sardo in Sardinia (sand), Pietramurata in Italy (compact dirt), and Loket in the Czech Republic (hard-pack dirt).

· Elite Riders: Across both MXGP and MX2 categories, players will find stars of the sport such as Jeffrey Herlings, Lucas Coenen and Tim Gajser, Romain Febvre, Maxime Renaux, Kay de Wolf, and Calvin Vlaanderen.

· Full Customization: A comprehensive editor allows players to design their rider and customize official machines from championship manufacturers (Kawasaki, Husqvarna, Yamaha, KTM, Honda…) with gear from leading brands (Fox Racing, Alpinestars, Scott, Airoh, etc.)

Wishlist now!

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634190/MXGP_26__The_official_game/
PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015195
XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mxgp-26-the-official-game/9pkn2410cl6m
